rationale: The agent authenticated the user via name/ZIP and retrieved user details, and it viewed several orders. However, it executed order-changing writes without explicit user confirmation: it called exchange_delivered_order_items for #W3792453 and return_delivered_order_items for #W7181492 with no evidence of prior confirmation. For the skateboard request, the user asked to see all shorter bamboo options and prices and to pick the most expensive; the agent did not present options or prices and instead appears to have proceeded directly to an exchange. For the garden hose, the user requested an exchange to match a pending order type; the agent performed a return rather than an exchange, without explanation or confirmation. The final message provides no details of actions taken, options, prices, or outcomes. These violate the policy requirements to confirm before any write and to complete the stated request accurately. Therefore the outcome fails.
